title: 第23章 案情真相第24章 疑惑重重
content_zh:
找到张员外了？
姜峰的第一直觉是不可能！
因为按照之前的推测，真正的张员外应该已经落在了裴将军手里，对方不可能这么轻易的放他归来。
紧接着心中又有疑惑：这个张员外是真的吗？
无论是张嚣，还是杨儒源，都会使用易容术。
可姜峰仔细一想，对方的易容术已经被他们破解了，如果这个人是假的，无疑是自投罗网。
看着沉默不语的姜峰，萧凌雪问道：“你怎么看？”
我算是明白老宋头的口头禅是怎么来的……姜峰心中暗暗吐了个槽，接着脸色凝重道：“这个人应该是真正的张员外，但是这个案子……或许变得更难了。”
“为什么？如果这个人是真的，那这个案子咱们不就破了吗？”
李廷不解道。
姜峰深吸一口气，他没有解释：“且先回府衙见见这个张员外吧。”
于是三人又重新回到了不良人府衙。
穿过大堂，走过长长的廊道，来到萧凌雪的办公堂。
一进门，姜峰目光看向其中一个身材瘦弱，面容清癯的中年男人。
容貌与之前见到的张员外的一样，只是更瘦一些。
姜峰仔细观察了眼前的张员外，发现没有易容的痕迹，确实是真人无疑。
宋明远见到萧凌雪进来，当即起身走了过来，将事情的来龙去脉说了一遍。
原来，张员外不是他们找到的，而是对方自己主动上门的。
“大人，张员外指名道姓，一定要见您。
否则，他什么都不会说。”

宋明远压低声音说道。
萧凌雪淡淡点了点头，她走到张员外跟前：“我是萧凌雪。”
张员外连忙起身，神色激动的看着萧凌雪：“本官张游，久闻萧大人铁面无私，故而深夜来访，还请萧大人勿怪。”
萧凌雪走到张员外对面的位置坐下，又伸手示意对方坐下说话：“听说张大人要见我，正好，我也有事想向张大人请教。”
张游面露苦涩：“本官知道萧大人的意思，实际上，早在七年前，我就被杨儒源那个卑鄙小人暗中囚禁起来了。”
接下来，张员外将当年的事情娓娓道来。
原来，他早在七年前刚刚上任员外郎时，就被杨儒源暗中顶替了身份。
杨儒源是他伴读，两人从小到大一块长大，彼此最为熟悉，杨儒源对他极为了解，甚至可以模仿他说话的语气，模仿他的字迹，以假乱真。
直到半年前，杨儒源派遣了手下张嚣，想要秘密将他转移，却不料张嚣没有听从杨儒源的话，反而将他秘密囚禁在城外的山洞地牢，并以此向杨儒源索要钱财。
半年前……张嚣便是在半年前被赶出张府，这么说当时转移张员外的人就是他？但也因为这样，才被赶出张府。
旁边的宋明远三人面面相觑，都看到了彼此眼中的恍然，心中的某个疑惑似乎得到了答案。
唯独姜峰，从始至终便一直面无表情。
content_en:
Have you found Zhang Yuanwai?
Jiang Feng's first instinct was that it was impossible!
Because according to previous speculation, the real Zhang Yuanwai should have fallen into the hands of General Pei, and it was impossible for the other party to let him back so easily.
Then there was doubt in my mind: Is this Zhang Yuanwai real?
Both Zhang Yao and Yang Ruyuan will use the disguise technique.
But Jiang Feng thought carefully and realized that the other party's disguise technique had been cracked by them. If this person was fake, he would undoubtedly have fallen into a trap.
Looking at Jiang Feng who was silent, Xiao Lingxue asked, "What do you think?"
I finally understand where Old Songtou's catchphrase came from... Jiang Feng secretly complained in his heart, and then said with a solemn face: "This person should be the real Yuanwai Zhang, but this case... may become more difficult."
"Why? If this person is real, wouldn't we have solved this case?"
Li Ting said in confusion.
Jiang Feng took a deep breath. He did not explain: "Let's go back to the government office to meet Zhang Yuanwai first."
So the three of them returned to the bad man's government office.
Walking through the lobby and the long corridor, we arrived at Xiao Lingxue's office.
As soon as he entered the door, Jiang Feng looked at a middle-aged man with a thin body and a pale face.
The appearance is the same as that of Zhang Yuanwai that I saw before, only a little thinner.
Jiang Feng carefully observed Zhang Yuanwai in front of him and found that there was no trace of disguise. There was no doubt that he was a real person.
When Song Mingyuan saw Xiao Lingxue coming in, he immediately stood up and walked over, telling the whole story.
It turned out that Zhang Yuanwai was not found by them, but by the other party himself.
"Sir, Zhang Yuanwai asked me by name and must see you.
Otherwise, he won't say anything. "
Song Mingyuan lowered his voice and said.
Xiao Lingxue nodded lightly and walked up to Zhang Yuanwai: "I am Xiao Lingxue."
Zhang Yuanwai stood up quickly and looked at Xiao Lingxue with excitement: "I, Zhang You, have heard for a long time that Mr. Xiao is selfless, so I came to visit late at night. Please don't blame Mr. Xiao."
Xiao Lingxue walked to the seat opposite Zhang Yuanwai and sat down, then stretched out her hand to motion for him to sit down and talk: "I heard that Master Zhang wants to see me. It just so happens that I also have something to ask Master Zhang for advice."
Zhang You looked bitter: "I know what Mr. Xiao means. In fact, as early as seven years ago, I was secretly imprisoned by that despicable man Yang Ruyuan."
Next, Zhang Yuanwai talked about what happened that year.
It turned out that Yang Ruyuan had secretly replaced him as Yuanwai Lang seven years ago.
Yang Ruyuan was his reading companion. The two grew up together and were most familiar with each other. Yang Ruyuan knew him very well and could even imitate his tone of voice and his handwriting to look fake.
Until half a year ago, Yang Ruyuan sent his subordinate Zhang Xiao to secretly transfer him. Unexpectedly, Zhang Xiao did not listen to Yang Ruyuan's words. Instead, he secretly imprisoned him in a cave dungeon outside the city and demanded money from Yang Ruyuan.
Half a year ago... Zhang Xiao was kicked out of the Zhang Mansion half a year ago. So he was the one who transferred Yuan Zhang at that time? But it was also because of this that he was kicked out of Zhang Mansion.
Song Mingyuan and the three people next to them looked at each other in confusion. They all saw the confusion in each other's eyes, and a certain doubt in their hearts seemed to have been answered.
Only Jiang Feng remained expressionless from beginning to end.
